dates: 1772-1834
---

poet

Grandfather of Christabel Rose Coleridge. CMY was not related to him, but to his sister-in-law Frances Duke (Taylor) Coleridge (1760-1838), wife of his brother James (1759-1836).

Frances Duke Coleridge was first cousin of CMY\'s grandfather the Rev.

Duke Yonge, their mothers being sisters called Duke.
